response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM order_counts), scored AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM scored WHERE share > overall_average_share
